summary: Agent repeatedly asked for more details and never provided office hours, guidance, or escalation; missed safety and scheduling needs.

issues.description: The patient clearly asked for office hours and after-hours options multiple times, but the agent failed to recognize or act on the intent.
issues.recommendation: Add robust intent recognition for common requests (e.g., office hours). On first detection, provide hours or ask a targeted clarifying question (e.g., which location/provider). If information isn’t available, retrieve from knowledge base or immediately escalate to human.

issues.description: The agent repeated the same prompt ('Can you provide more details?') throughout the call, creating an unproductive loop.
issues.recommendation: Implement loop detection and response variation. After one failed clarification, paraphrase the user’s request; after two failures, escalate or provide alternative resources (website, voicemail). Set a maximum of two generic reprompts.

issues.description: Did not provide office hours, ask for location/provider context, offer to schedule, or direct the patient to official hour listings.
issues.recommendation: When asked about hours, confirm the clinic/location, present standard hours and any evening/weekend availability, note holiday variations, and offer to schedule. If data unavailable, provide the website/portal link or transfer to front desk.

issues.description: Patient asked about urgent visit options; the agent gave no triage guidance or emergency/after-hours instructions.
issues.recommendation: Add safety triage. When 'urgent' or 'after-hours' is mentioned, advise calling 911 for life-threatening emergencies, provide on-call/urgent care info if available, and offer to connect to after-hours line.

issues.description: Lacked empathy, intent paraphrasing, targeted clarifications, or next-step guidance; conversation felt robotic and unhelpful.
issues.recommendation: Adopt best practices: acknowledge the request, paraphrase, ask specific clarifiers (e.g., location), provide concrete info or actions, and close with a helpful summary or escalation.

issues.description: Agent failed to offer alternative channels (website, portal, voicemail) or a warm transfer when unable to provide hours.
issues.recommendation: Provide self-service options (URL to hours, portal), offer to send details via SMS/email, or transfer to staff. Provide recorded hours via IVR when live data unavailable.

issues.description: Likely violates call-handling policies by persisting in a loop without escalation and omitting emergency/urgent care disclaimers.
issues.recommendation: Enforce policies: maximum reprompts, mandatory emergency disclaimer on urgent cues, and auto-escalation to a human after repeated misunderstandings.

issues.description: No incorrect facts were given; however, the absence of information created confusion and unmet needs.
issues.recommendation: When data is unavailable, clearly state limitations and provide reliable alternatives (transfer, website, callback).
Maintain the practice of not guessing. Pair with effective retrieval and escalation so correctness does not come at the cost of usefulness.

issues.description: Not applicable; medications were not discussed.
issues.recommendation: No action needed for this call. Ensure future workflows can answer or route refill requests promptly.
